title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
**Location** 





 Onsite \- Noida, India
 




  





**Employment Type** 





 Full\-time
 




  





**Reporting To** 





 Founder
 




  





**Experience Required** 





 2\-4 years 
 




  





**Qualifications** 





 Graduate (B.Tech in IT or Computer Science preferred)
 




  





**About the role** 





 We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer (Playwright or Selenium) who will be responsible for ensuring that all our digital products\- Mobile applications (Android, Flutter), websites (NEXT.js, React), and backend systems, meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
 





 The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, logical, and organized, with a strong technical understanding of both automation and manual testing processes. You will work closely with developers to write, maintain, and optimize test cases, ensuring every deployment is smooth, bug\-free, and reliable.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Ensure end\-to\-end product quality across Android applications, NEXT.js and React websites, and backend systems.
* Write, execute, and maintain test cases for all applications and ensure they are updated as systems evolve.
* Ensure proper documentation and organization of all test cases and testing processes.
* Collaborate with developers to identify and fix bugs quickly, ensuring high\-quality releases.
* Use Playwright, Selenium, and Postman for automation and API testing.
* Analyze bugs, log issues, and track them through resolution using project management tools.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, test automation frameworks, and standards.
* Proficiency with testing frameworks, automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, Cypress), and API testing.
* Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Proficiency in Python/Node.js for writing test scripts.
* Strong understanding of programming languages: Node, Java, Dart, JavaScript.
* Database familiarity: Firebase, PostgreSQL, MySQL.
* Experience with Postman, Playwright, and Selenium.
* Working knowledge of REST API testing (Postman/Newman, curl, or pytest requests).
* Excellent test case organization and documentation abilities.
* Strong logical thinking, analytical mindset, and problem\-solving orientation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders.



  





**Success Metrics / KPIs** 



* Bug\-Free Deployments: Measured reduction in critical post\-deployment issues.
* Number of Deployments: Increased volume of stable and verified releases.
* Speed of Testing: Reduced turnaround time between builds and QA sign\-off.
* Test Coverage: Comprehensive test case coverage across all modules and products.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Highly logical and analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem\-solving.
* Meticulous and organized in handling documentation and multiple test scenarios.
* Collaborative mindset, working effectively with developers and product teams.
* Passionate about quality assurance, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Self\-driven and reliable, with a strong sense of accountability and ownership for product quality.



  





**About the Company** 





 SayaCare is a fast\-growing e\-health company dedicated to making healthcare and wellness simple, accessible, and personalized. Founded in 2021, we combine technology, care, and innovation to deliver reliable health solutions to our community. At Sayacare, we value collaboration, learning, and human\-focused solutions, and we are building a team that’s passionate, creative, and committed to improving lives.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti\-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
   

  

 At OneSpan, we're looking for a hands\-on
 **QA Automation Engineer** 
 to write and maintain automated tests across our iOS and Android SDKs and help grow our automation coverage as the SDKs evolve. You have experience in mobile test frameworks and enough fluency in the SDK code to write and maintain reliable tests — you don't need to be a full iOS or Android app developer. Our Mobile Security Suite (MSS) spans multiple SDKs across iOS, Android, and server\-side platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Write Automated Tests: Design and implement automated test cases across our iOS and Android SDKs, using XCTest and XCUITest on iOS, and Compose\-compatible testing tools on Android.
* Build \& Maintain Automation: Maintain and extend existing automated test suites and CI pipelines, and build new test coverage as SDKs evolve and new features ship.
* Run \& Triage Tests: Execute automated test runs using real\-device cloud testing tools, and triage and report test failures.
* Support the Pipelines: Work with GitLab CI (YAML) pipelines, Bash scripts, and Gradle across our multiple SDK pipelines, making updates and improvements as needed.
* Collaborate: Work closely with the automation team, manual QA engineers, and feature developers to keep test coverage current as new features and SDK versions ship.
* Document: Keep test case documentation, known issues, and maintenance notes up to date for the team.


**Required Technical Skills**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in mobile test automation (or mobile development moving into test automation).
* Mobile test automation in at least one mobile stack — iOS (Swift, XCTest/XCUITest) or Android (Kotlin, Compose Test/Espresso/UI Automator); able to read the SDK code well enough to test it.
* CI/CD \& Scripting: Familiarity with GitLab CI and YAML pipelines, Bash scripting, and Gradle.
* Ability to read, understand, and extend an existing automation framework and test suite.
* Git and standard version control workflows.


**Nice to Have**
* Familiarity with AI coding tools/assistants to speed up test writing and maintenance.

title: Senior Model Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**The Role**
 Energy, Economy and Environment modelling as part of WSP plc develops and maintains large\-scale applied mathematical models that represent the energy, environment and economy, supporting quantitative analysis and policy design. Its integrated modelling tools provide informed, transparent and robust analysis as well as recommendations for its high\-profile clients which include the European Commission, national governments, energy regulators and a number of private companies in the energy and transport sectors, financial institutions and strategic consultancies. This role is about supporting the Chief Modelling Engineer to improve the design of the models operations (data collection/harmonisation, database access, HPC computing, model development principles).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Suggest, design, and implement modelling automation routines to improve workflow efficiency in cooperation with the energy and economic modelling teams.
* Design and maintain data workflows and quality assurance processes for large modelling databases (inputs, intermediate outputs, and results).
* Develop and operate automated data extraction pipelines via APIs to feed models with timely and consistent datasets.
* Configure and use HPC/cluster computing and parallel processing solutions to run large\-scale simulations and batch model runs.
* Develop and maintain internal tools and scripts for workflow orchestration, including scheduling, monitoring, and logging of model runs.
* Help develop and maintain internal tools for version control, continuous integration, unit testing, backup and documentation using Git/GitHub and similar applications.
* Build dashboards and visual analytics in Power BI or equivalent tools for monitoring model performance, scenario results, and key indicators.
* Integrate LLM\-based components into modelling workflows for data processing, semi\-automated calibration, and result summarization.
* Liaise with the Data Science group and modelling teams for the exchange of tools and methods, ensuring best practices in automation and data management are adopted.
* Assist with troubleshooting and problem\-solving when issues arise in automated pipelines, HPC jobs, or LLM\-powered tools.


**Qualifications**
**Key competencies and experience**
* Hold a BSc and/or MSc degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, or an adjacent quantitative field.
* Experience in managing large databases and data pipelines, including SQL and at least one NoSQL technology.
* Demonstrated experience using automation tools and scripting/programming languages (e.g. Python, shell scripting, R; experience with GAMS or similar modelling languages is an asset).
* Experience with automated data extraction and integration via APIs.
* Experience using or administering High\-Performance Computing (HPC) or cluster environments, and familiarity with parallel processing.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub workflows for collaborative development and version control.
* Experience with Power BI or equivalent visualization/BI tools.
* Demonstrated experience or strong interest in applying LLMs in technical environments (e.g. auxiliary tools for data processing, summarization, or code assistance).
* Be proficient in verbal and written communication in English.
* Have a detail\-oriented and problem\-solving mindset, a collaborative attitude and willingness to learn and adopt new tools.
